name: NEB Network AR
subtitle: AR experiences by Hochschule Anhalt
description: Official AltStore source for NEB Network AR (Hochschule Anhalt).

apps.name: NEB Network AR
apps.subtitle: Augmented reality portals
apps.localizedDescription: NEB Network AR opens augmented reality experiences: scan a printed QR marker to see dreams and portals placed in the real world around you.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used for augmented reality: tracking your surroundings and recognising printed markers.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Opens AR experiences served from computers on your local network during development.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location lets an experience show places near you on its map.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone is used when an experience asks to record your voice, for example to leave a voice comment.
